age.evidence: Experiments began when rats were in mid adolescence, comprised between post-natal days (PND) 34-46

dosing.evidence: acute dose of 0.3 or 1 mg/kg of psilocybin or saline (0.9% NaCl)... repeated psilocybin (0.3 and 1 mg/kg, 7 days, 1 dose/day, o.g.); i.p. vs o.g. routes compared.

handling.evidence: Rats were handled at least 1 day (PND 34) before any experimental procedure started.

group_housing.evidence: After weaning rats were housed in groups of 2-4 rats per sex in standard cages.

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 h light/dark cycle, with lights on at 08:00 a.m. All the procedures were performed during the light period

enrichment_housing.evidence: housed in groups of 2-4 rats per sex in standard cages (no mention of enrichment)

assays.assay_description: Square open field chamber (60 × 60 × 40 cm); rats placed immediately after psilocybin (i.p. or o.g.); head-twitch responses manually scored from 5-30 min by a blinded experimenter.

application_type.evidence: comparing the i.p. vs. o.g. routes of administration

setup_habituation.evidence: no apparatus habituation described prior to test

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was placed in the arena, and behavior was recorded for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: open field chamber - no food accessible during recording

water_restriction.evidence: open field chamber - no water accessible during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following psilocybin... administration, each rat was placed in the arena, and behavior was recorded for 30 min

sample_size.evidence: 43 adolescent Sprague Dawley rats (21 males and 22 females)... 1 mg/kg of psilocybin i.p. (n = 5; 1 male, 4 females)

outcomes.summary: Acute psilocybin 1 mg/kg increased head-twitch responses (~+5.3 vs saline) independently of administration route (i.p. vs o.g.); 0.3 mg/kg was not significant in the ANOVA but was significant in a direct t-test vs. saline.
outcomes.evidence: 1 mg/kg of psilocybin increased head-twitch responses independently of the route of administration (+5.3 head-twitch responses vs. saline-treated rats; p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total head-twitch counts... were used for statistical comparisons

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total head-twitch counts, across the 5-30 min observation period, were used

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch is a pharmacological proxy, explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: individually assessed in a square open field chamber

B7_automated_classification.evidence: manually scored by a single trained experimenter blinded to treatment

E3_bedding.evidence: chambers were cleaned with 70% ethanol - bare floor implied

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in arena

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recorded for this assay

D5_followup.evidence: No follow-up recordings ≥24 h after dose

assays.assay_description: Same 60 × 60 × 40 cm open field arena; 30 min recording immediately after psilocybin (i.p. or o.g.); total distance travelled tracked with SMART Video Tracking System.

application_type.evidence: 0.3 or 1 mg/kg of psilocybin by i.p. vs. o.g.

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was placed in the arena... behavior was recorded for 30 min

food_restriction.evidence: Open field - no food in arena

water_restriction.evidence: Open field - no water in arena

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following psilocybin... administration, each rat was placed in the arena

sample_size.evidence: Same cohort as the head-twitch experiment (43 rats across six groups)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.3 or 1 mg/kg, i.p. or o.g.) did not change total distance travelled in a novel open field compared with saline.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin did not induce changes in locomotion in a novel environment, as observed by the lack of effect of treatment

assays.assay_description: Water tank (41 cm high × 32 cm diameter, 25 cm depth, 25 ± 1 °C). 15 min pre-test (PND 34) followed by 5 min test sessions at 30 min post-acute dose (PND 35), and 1, 8, and 15 days post-repeated dosing (PND 42, 49, 56). Manual scoring of immobility, climbing, and swimming.

application_type.evidence: oral psilocybin (0.3 and 1 mg/kg, 2 ml/kg, o.g.)

setup_habituation.evidence: during the pre-test session, each rat was individually placed in a water tank... for 15 min (PND 34)

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder - per rubric, FST counts as restraint

food_restriction.evidence: FST tank - no food accessible during the 5 min test

water_restriction.evidence: Water is the testing medium, not for drinking

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min after the first psilocybin administration at PND 35... evaluated at different time-points after treatment (1, 8 and 15 days)

sample_size.evidence: 60 adolescent Sprague Dawley rats (30 males and 30 females)... divided in 3 experimental groups of 20 rats each (10 males and 10 females)

outcomes.summary: Acute oral psilocybin (0.3 and 1 mg/kg) reduced immobility and increased climbing and swimming 30 min post-dose. Repeated 7-day dosing produced antidepressant-like effects at 1, 8, and 15 days post-treatment; the 1 mg/kg dose maintained efficacy across timepoints while the 0.3 mg/kg dose gradually lost efficacy on climbing/swimming by 8-15 days. Effects independent of sex.
outcomes.statistics: Acute immobility: F2,57 = 18.81, p < 0.001; climbing F2,57 = 6.69, p = 0.003; swimming F2,57 = 17.18, p < 0.001. 1-day immobility F2,57 = 22.46, p < 0.001. 8-day immobility F2,57 = 17.04, p < 0.001. 15-day immobility F2,57 = 9.49, p < 0.001
outcomes.evidence: both doses of psilocybin decreased the time rats spent immobile when compared to saline-treated rats... the dose of 0.3 mg/kg of psilocybin lost its efficacy for climbing and swimming 8- and 15-days post-treatment

B1_num_measures.evidence: immobility, climbing, and swimming each scored separately (3 measures)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: 5 min test - single total per behaviour reported

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility explicitly excluded from ethological per rubric

B5_social.evidence: each rat was individually placed in a water tank

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST is not a learning task

B7_automated_classification.evidence: videos were blindly analyzed... Behavioral Tracker software - manual scoring

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate univariate ANOVAs per behaviour; a correlation with NeuroD1 is bivariate, not multivariate

E1_environment_type.evidence: water tank (41 cm high x 32 cm diameter)

D1_continuity.evidence: Pre-test (PND 34), and test sessions on PND 35, 42, 49 and 56

D3_recording_days.evidence: PND 34 (pre-test), PND 35, PND 42, PND 49, PND 56 = 5 recording days

D4_baseline.evidence: during the pre-test session, each rat was individually placed in a water tank... for 15 min (PND 34)

D5_followup.evidence: antidepressant-like response... evaluated at different time-points after treatment (1, 8 and 15 days)

judge_notes: Three assays retained: HTR, open-field locomotion, and FST. HTR and OFT locomotion were run in the same apparatus but measure different behavioural domains (per rubric, these are separate assays).

FST: collapsed acute (30 min post-dose) and repeated-dose follow-ups (1, 8, 15 days) into one assay with multiple recording sessions, per assay-identity rule (different timepoints of same paradigm = one assay).
D2 for FST scored 1 (15-60 min) because the pre-test session was 15 min, even though test sessions were 5 min — longest single session governs.

B1 for FST scored 2 (4-6 measures interpreted from rubric: immobility + climbing + swimming = 3 distinct measures fall in the 2-3 bin, score 1). Corrected: 3 measures = bin 2-3 = score 1. Setting B1 score=1, raw_total updated.
Setup_habituation for HTR/OFT marked 'not_reported' (paper is silent on apparatus pre-exposure beyond general handling).
Setup_restrain for FST set to 'yes' per rubric (FST cylinder is listed as a restraint apparatus).
Immunohistochemistry for Ki-67/NeuroD1/BrdU is histological and not scored as a behavioural assay.
